recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if the Kindling diagram renderer regresses or if a human explicitly asks to regenerate checked-in SVG artifacts as separate build maintenance.
issue_request: FHIR-17767 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that Element in data type diagrams be a hyperlink to the Element definition page.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#989ce5acbb. That commit exists as 989ce5acbb78e72435e14a9c18d2c2b959559bf0 and changed the then in-repo SvgGenerator so generated Element diagram text was wrapped in an SVG anchor.
additional_context: The current FHIR source no longer owns SvgGenerator directly; build.gradle.kts uses the external HL7 Kindling dependency. Current source keeps Element as an active infrastructure type, maps element to the types page, and renders datatypes/abstracts.diagram from source/types.html. Current Kindling renders linked class titles with makeLink(tn), and build.fhir.org/types.html contains xlink:href="types.html#Element">Element. FHIR-33207 is a later same-link-family issue about links from datatype UML element rows to definition pages, not this Element class-title hyperlink.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative source and generator path already satisfy the requested hyperlink; editing source/datatypes/primitives.svg alone would be a generated-artifact-only change and is not appropriate for this reconciliation.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue in the datatype UML link family; it addressed detailed element-row links such as ElementDefinition.constraint.expression and did not supersede FHIR-17767.
